definitions.explanation: A large area of land used for raising livestock such as cattle, horses, or sheep, typically with grazing pastures.

examples.japanese: {北海道|ほっかいどう}の{牧場|ぼくじょう}を{訪|おとず}れた。
examples.english: I visited a ranch in Hokkaido.

examples.japanese: {牧場|ぼくじょう}で{牛|うし}を{飼|か}っている。
examples.english: They raise cattle on the ranch.

examples.japanese: {観光|かんこう}{牧場|ぼくじょう}で{乳搾|ちちしぼ}り{体験|たいけん}をした。
examples.english: I experienced milking at a tourist ranch.

notes:
USAGE:
{牧場|ぼくじょう} can also be read as {牧場|まきば} in some contexts, though {牧場|ぼくじょう} is more common. {牧場|まきば} has a more poetic or traditional feel.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{牧場|ぼくじょう}で{働|はたら}く (work on a ranch)
・{牧場|ぼくじょう}を{経営|けいえい}する (run a ranch)
・{観光|かんこう}{牧場|ぼくじょう} (tourist ranch)

REGIONAL NOTE:
Hokkaido is famous for its large {牧場|ぼくじょう}, particularly for dairy farming ({酪農|らくのう}).

RELATED TERMS:
・{牧畜|ぼくちく} (livestock farming)
・{放牧|ほうぼく} (grazing)
・{酪農|らくのう} (dairy farming)
